services.enable: out=$(dinitctl enable {service_name} 2>&1) || {{ printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'already enabled' || {{ printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 1; }}; }}
services.enable_offline: out=$(dinitctl --offline enable {service_name} 2>&1) || {{ printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'already enabled' || {{ printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 1; }}; }}
